42:52.text: And thus We have sent to you
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
of Our Command. You knew not what is the Book, nor what is Faith? But We have made it
a light wherewith We guide whosoever of Our slaves We will. And verily, you
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)

42:53.text: The Path of Allâh to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Verily, all matters at the end go to Allâh

43:2.text: (i.e. this Qur’ân that makes things clear)

43:3.text: Verily, We have made it a Qur’ân in Arabic that you may be able to understand

43:4.text: is in the Mother of the Book
, with Us, indeed exalted, full of wisdom.

43:5.text: from you, because you are a people Musrifûn.

43:6.text: And how many a Prophet have We sent amongst the men of old.

43:7.text: And never came there a Prophet to them but they used to mock at him.

43:8.text: than these - and the example of the ancients has passed away

43:9.text: And indeed if you ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" They will surely say: "The All-Mighty, the All-Knower created them."

43:10.text: Who has made for you the earth like a bed, and has made for you roads therein, in order that you may find your way.
